title: UC-004 Lane A: public/fleet+track, pricing, rating, common-routes, my-orders, geo-suggest widen
coverage_delta: +41 new tests (283 -> 324 total). All 7 UC-004 Lane-A WIs covered with happy-path + each error/validation path + a tenant-isolation integration test per feature. Two pre-existing tests updated in place (GeoProxyTests.Suggest_NonDispatcher_Returns403 repurposed Customer->Driver since suggest is now CustomerOrStaff; SeedAndEndToEndTests OpenAPI allowlist + api.md regen for the 7 new routes).
notes: All 7 WIs DONE (staged + green). Per-WI decisions: D1 (A-public-fleet) GetFleetEndpoint is EndpointWithoutRequest + AllowAnonymous; guards CurrentTenant.FleetId null->404 (no unscoped query); Fleet is NOT ITenantEntity so scoping is the explicit Where(f=>f.Id==FleetId); PrimaryColorHex nullable varchar(7); migration AddFleetPrimaryColor sequenced FIRST. D2 (A-track) F-03 applied: CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals for the HMAC signature compare (never == / SequenceEqual). F-04 applied: fixed 24h mint window; the '2h after completion' rule is enforced at VALIDATION time in TrackingTokenService.Validate against order.CompletedAt, NOT at mint; dev Tracking:HmacKey added ONLY to appsettings.Development.json (prod key wiring deferred to assignment 08, documented in TrackingOptions xmldoc). Token layout Base64Url("{exp}.{Base64Url(HMAC(key,\"{orderId}:{exp}\"))}") — orderId supplied at validate time from the fleet-scoped public-code lookup, so the HMAC binds token<->order. Raw token/key never logged. TrackByCodeResponse is a NEW file (TrackOrderResponse left untouched); display price = FinalPriceCzk ?? FixedPriceCzk ?? EstimatedPriceCzk. AC#3 MISSING-token fix: designer listed a TrackByCodeValidator but a NotEmpty(K) rule would force a 400 on a missing ?k= which contradicts AC#3 ('bad, MISSING, expired, or tampered -> 410'); removed the validator entirely (Code is a route param that cannot be absent) so a missing token flows to the endpoint's Validate(req.K ?? string.Empty,...)->false->410. Shape: known code + missing/bad token -> 410; unknown code -> 404 first (no-leak). Covered by Track_MissingToken_Returns410. Customer create-order now mints a token and returns trackingCode/trackingToken/trackingUrlPath (/c/t/{code}?k={token}) as additive siblings to the { order } envelope; dispatcher create unaffected (isCustomer gate). D3 (A-rating) F-02 applied EXACTLY: OrderDetailDto gained int? RatingStars=null, string? RatingComment=null, DateTimeOffset? RatedAt=null as trailing-optional positional params WITH matching <param> docs (avoids CS1573); all ~13 construction sites compile unchanged; only GetOrderEndpoint (dispatcher detail, AC#7) populates them, OrderDetailMapper.ToDto + CreateOrderEndpoint.ToDetailDto leave them defaulted. RateOrderRequest uses plain (non-required) props (STJ trap); POST orders/{id}/rating CustomerOnly+owner-only (no-leak 404), Completed-only (409 Order.NotCompleted), once (409 Order.AlreadyRated), Version++ on save. Migration AddOrderRating sequenced AFTER AddFleetPrimaryColor (snapshot rebases cleanly). D4 (A-pricing) CustomerOnly; string coords parsed InvariantCulture (locale trap); validator uses double.TryParse(InvariantCulture); fixed match = enabled/non-deleted/valid-now PointToPoint route within ~0.005deg (~500m) of both endpoints ordered by Priority desc; else tariff estimate = Max(MinimumFareCzk, round(BaseFareCzk+PerKmCzk*km)) then +/-10% rounded to 10 CZK with a MinEstimateSpreadCzk=20 guard so EstimateLow<EstimateHigh ALWAYS (AC#4 never-exact); no dropoff -> wide band from tariff minimum (no upstream call); OSRM failure -> 502 Geo.RouteUnavailable (reused code); no tenant -> 400 NoTenantResolved (reused). D5 (A-common-routes) CustomerOnly, tenant-safe; valid-now computed in-memory from timeProvider->Europe/Prague (ValidDays bitmask Mon=1..Sun=64, time window null=all-day); no ErrorCodes change. D6 (A-my-orders) both endpoints under Features/Orders, tests under namespace Taxi.Api.Tests.Orders.Mine (single-filter rule); orders/mine/active returns single non-terminal (New/Assigned/Accepted/Arrived/InProgress) owned order or 204; orders/mine is standard {items,total,page,pageSize} with ListMyOrdersValidator bounding page>=1, pageSize 1..200 (reused PageMinOne/PageSizeRange codes); both own-rows (CustomerUserId==sub) + tenant-safe. D7 (A-geo-suggest) added CustomerOrStaff policy (Customer+Dispatcher+FleetAdmin) mirroring DispatcherOrCustomer precedent; SuggestEndpoint switched to it; geo/route NOT widened (stays DispatcherOrDriver; pricing/quote wraps it server-side). Pre-06 stubs: Zone/ZoneToZone route matching in pricing is PointToPoint-only for now; ETA/OSRM-derived arrival deferred to 06 (track DTO has no ETA field). New CLAUDE.md facts appended: WithTag-needs-Common.Features-using, FakeGeoProvider-shared-singleton-reset-first, OpenAPI-route-allowlist+api.md-regen, OrderDetailDto-trailing-optional-F-02. Did NOT touch web/** or .claude/state; staged only api/ docs/ CLAUDE.md.
